title: 第11章 何家被人做局第12章 柳云烟的冷漠让陈景言彻底寒心了
content_zh:
陈景言继续说：“你家东北方祠堂，本是藏风聚气之地，却被人暗置了‘五鬼运财’的变种局，名为‘引煞归元’。此局初看似乎能短期内聚拢财气，实则是将外界的阴煞之气引入宅中，初期家人或有小病小痛，不易察觉，日积月累，阴煞侵体，便会如老爷子这般，五脏六腑衰竭，形容枯槁，最终油尽灯枯，且祸及子孙运势。”
他顿了顿，走到窗边，望向何家庄园的东北方向，继续说道：“那动土之人，手法隐蔽，借返修之名，在祠堂地基下埋了三枚特制的‘阴煞铜钱’，呈三角之势，又以桃木为钉，钉入地脉。桃木本是辟邪之物，但若沾染了尸油，并以特殊符咒加持，反成引煞之媒。寻常风水师，不细查根本，极易被表象迷惑。”
何江南听得心惊肉跳，连忙追问：“小先生，那……那如今该如何是好？那阴煞铜钱和桃木钉，是否需要立即取出？”
陈景言摇头：“不急。此局已被我以‘五行归元’之法暂时压制，老爷子体内的生机反哺，也让宅内正气有所回升。现在强行破局，恐有煞气反扑，伤及旁人。待明日午时，阳气最盛之时，我自会出手。届时，需取无根之水，以阳气淬炼过的法器，将那三枚阴煞铜钱取出，再以‘镇魂符’镇住桃木钉上的邪祟，最后移至向阳处暴晒七日，其煞自解。至于祠堂，无需大动干戈，只需在正门两侧各摆放一尊一尺高的汉白玉麒麟，麒麟脚踏八卦，头朝东方，便可镇宅纳福，化解残余煞气，恢复原有风水格局。”
何羽生拊掌赞叹：“小先生不仅医术通神，于风水之道亦是见解独到，一针见血！若非小先生慧眼，我何家恐怕……”
说到此处，他不禁后怕不已，再次向陈景言深深一揖。
陈景言侧身避开，淡淡道：“举手之劳。何老只需记住，天道循环，报应不爽。那些暗中算计何家之人，此局不成，必有后招。你们近期行事需更为谨慎，尤其是何大公子，经此一事，当吸取教训，莫要再轻信外人谗言。”
何超金早已面如土灰，闻言连连点头：“小先生教训的是，我知错了。”
正说着，管家匆匆进来禀报，说是给陈景言购置的手机和办理的银行卡已经办妥。
何江南亲自将崭新的智能手机和银行卡双手奉上，并告知了银行卡密码。陈景言接过，简单查看了一下，便收入怀中。
“何先生，何老，天色不早，我也该告辞了。”陈景言看向窗外，“明日我会再来一趟，处理风水之事。”
何羽生连忙挽留：“小先生，今晚就在何家留宿，寒舍简单了一些，还要请小先生委屈一晚。”
何家如此慷慨，回到柳家还要遭受他们的白眼，留在何家，何家老老少少都对他感恩戴德，礼遇有加。
陈景言略一沉吟，便点头应允：“既如此，便叨扰了。只是我想明天去何家祖坟看看，一些不怀好意的恶人最喜欢在祖坟上做手脚。”
何羽生闻言肃然起敬，“好，那就有劳小先生了，明天一早，还要请小先生辛苦一趟。”
陈景言微微颔首，目光沉静如水：“祖坟乃一脉气运所系，明日辰时三刻，需踏着朝露前行，方能看清地底阴气流向。届时带路便是。”
何羽生郑重应下，心中更添几分敬服。
何江南犹豫了一下后问道：“到现在还不知道小先生尊姓大名，还要请小先生赐教。”
这个问题让陈景言为难了，他目光微凝，片刻后才缓缓道：“名姓不过浮尘，说了也毫无意义。我叫陈景言，我遇到一些不可思议的事情，现在很多事情我自己都解释不清楚，我只能装傻应付眼前的事，待时局流转，自会水落石出。还要请何家为我保密。”
何江南神色一凛，连忙拱手：“陈先生放心，陈先生今后就是何家最尊贵的客人。何家上下为陈先生马首是瞻。”

何家把陈景言当座上宾，用最好的茶，最好的食物招待他。
柳家到吃晚饭的时候，才发现陈景言不知所踪。
柳家上下把整个庄园找了一遍，却始终不见陈景言身影。
后来，门口的保安才说，陈景言一早就出门了，一直没有回来。
柳云烟对管家说：“给他打电话。”
管家有些为难了：“大小姐，姑爷好像没有手机。”
“什么？这个年代还有人没有手机？”
柳云烟一怔，她不敢相信，她这个江海市的天之骄女的丈夫竟然连手机都没有，太令人难以置信了。
柳家人都饿了，只能先吃饭。
直到晚上，陈景言还是没有回来，柳云烟坐在轮椅上，被助理推着来到庭院中，望着渐沉的暮色，心中疑虑愈深。
如果陈景言走丢了，或是有什么意外，柳家无法向外界交代。
柳家人最后只得动用私人关系调取监控，沿着陈景言离开的路线一路追踪。可他好像故意去了一些监控死角，无法追踪到他。
柳家派出去很多人寻找，江海市是千万以上人口的特大城市，找一个人，犹如大海捞针。
朝日出现，何家人带着陈景言来到何家祖坟。
晨光微露，山雾缭绕，陈景言立于坟前石阶，看到何家祖坟黑雾笼罩，阴气凝而不散，主家宅不宁、血脉受阻。和祖坟被人做了手脚有很大的关系。
他做法，破了何家祖坟禁制。
接着，陈景言指尖朱砂符箓燃起幽蓝火焰，顺着地脉裂痕缓缓渗入坟茔深处。
地底传来一声闷响，如同古墓翻身，阴气骤然翻涌，却又被符火尽数吞没。
片刻后，黑雾散尽，一道微弱的金光自坟心透出，似龙脉苏醒之兆。
陈景言闭目低语，额角渗出细汗，双手结印于胸前，口中念念有词，仿佛与地下某种古老力量沟通。

良久，他缓缓睁开眼，目光如炬：“禁制已破，今后何家家宅安宁，子孙昌隆可期。”
接着他们又回到何家，解除何家祠堂中的血咒封印。

content_en:
Chen Jingyan continued: "The ancestral hall in the northeast of your home was originally a place where wind and energy were stored, but someone secretly set up a variant of the 'Five Ghosts to Luck Wealth', called 'Introducing Evil to the Origin'. At first glance, this tactic seems to be able to gather wealth in a short period of time, but in fact it is a way to attract the outside world." If the Yin evil spirit is introduced into the house, the family members may have minor illnesses and pains at first, which are not easy to detect. Over time, the Yin evil spirit invades the body, and the internal organs will become exhausted and withered, and eventually the oil will run out, and the fortune of the children and grandchildren will be harmed. "
He paused, walked to the window, looked to the northeast of the He family manor, and continued: "The person who broke the ground used a hidden method. In the name of renovation, he buried three special 'Yinsha copper coins' in the shape of a triangle under the foundation of the ancestral hall. The peach wood is used as a nail to ward off evil spirits, but if it is contaminated with corpse oil and blessed with special charms, it can become a medium for attracting evil spirits. Ordinary Feng Shui masters do not examine the root cause carefully and are easily fooled by the appearance."
He Jiangnan was frightened when he heard this, and quickly asked: "Little sir, then... what should we do now? Do the Yinsha copper coins and peach wood nails need to be taken out immediately?"
Chen Jingyan shook his head: "There is no rush. This situation has been temporarily suppressed by me with the method of 'Five Elements Returning to Origin'. The vitality in the old man's body has fed back, and the righteousness in the house has recovered. If I break the situation forcibly, I am afraid that the evil energy will counterattack and hurt others. I will take action at noon tomorrow, when the Yang Qi is at its strongest. At that time, I will need to take rootless water and use the magic weapon tempered by Yang Qi to convert the three Take out a Yin evil copper coin, and then use the 'Soul Soul Talisman' to suppress the evil spirits on the peach wood nail, and finally move it to a sunny place to expose it for seven days, and the evil spirits will resolve themselves. As for the ancestral hall, there is no need to go to war, just place a one-foot-tall white jade unicorn on both sides of the main entrance.
He Yusheng held up his palms and praised: "The young gentleman is not only a master of medicine, but also has unique insights into Feng Shui. He is right to the point! If it weren't for the young gentleman's insight, I, the He family, would probably..."
Having said this, he couldn't help but feel scared and bowed deeply to Chen Jingyan again.
Chen Jingyan sidestepped and said calmly: "It's a simple matter. Mr. He just needs to remember that heaven's law is cyclical and retribution will not be happy. Those who secretly plot against the He family will have a follow-up plan if this situation fails. You need to be more cautious in your actions in the near future, especially Mr. He. After this incident, you should learn a lesson and don't believe in the slander of outsiders again."
He Chaojin's face was already ashen, and he nodded repeatedly when he heard this: "What the young gentleman taught me is that I know I was wrong."
Just as he was talking, the housekeeper hurried in to report that the mobile phone purchased for Chen Jingyan and the bank card had been processed.
He Jiangnan personally presented the brand new smartphone and bank card with both hands, and informed the bank card password. Chen Jingyan took it, checked it briefly, and put it in his arms.
"Mr. He, Mr. He, it's getting late, it's time for me to say goodbye." Chen Jingyan looked out the window, "I will come again tomorrow to deal with Feng Shui matters."
He Yusheng hurriedly persuaded him to stay: "Little sir, I will stay at He's house tonight. The humble residence is a little simpler, but I also want to treat the little gentleman to a night of humiliation."
The He family was so generous that even when he returned to the Liu family, he would be looked down upon by them. But when he stayed in the He family, he was treated with great courtesy by all the young and old in the He family.
Chen Jingyan pondered for a moment, then nodded in agreement: "In that case, I'm sorry to bother you. It's just that I want to go to the He family's ancestral graves tomorrow. Some evil people with bad intentions like to do tricks on the ancestral graves."
He Yusheng was in awe when he heard this, "Okay, then I'll ask you, Mr. Lao. I'll ask you to do some hard work tomorrow morning."
Chen Jingyan nodded slightly, his eyes as calm as water: "The ancestral graves are connected by a line of luck. Tomorrow at three o'clock in the morning, we need to walk on the morning dew to see clearly the flow of Yin Qi in the ground. I will lead the way then."
He Yusheng solemnly agreed, feeling even more respectful.
He Jiangnan hesitated for a moment and then asked: "Until now, I still don't know that Mr.If a student has a distinguished surname, he should also ask for advice from a young teacher. "
This question put Chen Jingyan in a dilemma, his eyes narrowed slightly, and after a moment he slowly said: "The name is just a piece of dust, and it is meaningless to say it. My name is Chen Jingyan. I have encountered some incredible things. Now I can't explain many things clearly. I can only pretend to be stupid and deal with the things in front of me. When the situation changes, the truth will come to light. I also want to ask the He family to keep it a secret for me. "
He Jiangnan looked stern and quickly handed over his hand: "Mr. Chen, don't worry, Mr. Chen will be the most distinguished guest of the He family from now on. Everyone in the He family looked after Mr. Chen. "
The He family treated Chen Jingyan as a guest and entertained him with the best tea and the best food.
When the Liu family arrived for dinner, they discovered that Chen Jingyan was missing.
The Liu family searched the entire manor, but Chen Jingyan was nowhere to be found.
Later, the security guard at the door said that Chen Jingyan had left early in the morning and never came back.
Liu Yunyan said to the housekeeper: "Call him. "
The housekeeper was a little embarrassed: "Miss, I don't seem to have a mobile phone. "
"What? Is there anyone in this day and age who doesn’t have a mobile phone? "
Liu Yunyan was startled. She couldn't believe that her husband, the proud daughter of Jianghai City, didn't even have a mobile phone. It was unbelievable.
The Liu family were all hungry, so they had to eat first.
Until evening, Chen Jingyan still didn't come back. Liu Yunyan was sitting in a wheelchair and was pushed into the courtyard by his assistant. Looking at the sinking dusk, his doubts became deeper and deeper.
If Chen Jingyan gets lost or has an accident, the Liu family will not be able to explain it to the outside world.
In the end, the Liu family had no choice but to use their personal connections to call for surveillance and track Chen Jingyan's route. But it seems that he deliberately went to some surveillance blind spots, making it impossible to track him.
The Liu family sent out many people to search. Jianghai City is a huge city with a population of more than ten million. Finding someone is like finding a needle in a haystack.
The morning sun appeared, and the He family took Chen Jingyan to the He family's ancestral grave.
The morning light was slightly dew and the mountain mist was lingering. Chen Jingyan stood on the stone steps in front of the tomb and saw that the He family's ancestral tomb was shrouded in black mist. It has a lot to do with the tampering with the ancestral graves.
His approach broke the restriction on the He family's ancestral graves.
Then, the cinnabar talisman on Chen Jingyan's fingertips ignited a faint blue flame, slowly seeping into the depths of the tomb along the cracks in the earth veins.
There was a muffled sound from the ground, like an ancient tomb turning over, and the Yin Qi suddenly surged, only to be swallowed up by the talisman fire.
After a while, the black mist dissipated, and a faint golden light emerged from the heart of the tomb, like a sign that the dragon's veins were awakening.
Chen Jingyan closed his eyes and whispered, sweat dripping from his forehead, his hands forming seals on his chest, and mumbling words, as if communicating with some ancient power underground.
After a long time, he slowly opened his eyes, his eyes bright as fire: "The restriction has been broken. From now on, the He family's home will be peaceful, and their descendants can be prosperous. "
Then they returned to the He family and lifted the blood curse seal in the He family ancestral hall.
